canvas-mist.$description: Canvas Mist — Page background, hero canvas, alternating section bands

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Card surfaces, elevated panels, code-block backgrounds

inkstone.$description: Inkstone — Primary headings and body text — near-black with a faint cool tint that reads as black at any size

graphite.$description: Graphite — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Deepest dark fill for primary CTAs and nav inversion

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary headings and muted emphasis

pebble.$description: Pebble — Muted body text, helper labels, disabled copy

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text and nav idle state

mist-gray.$description: Mist Gray — De-emphasized labels and idle borders

lavender-stone.$description: Lavender Stone — Cool-tinted secondary text and icon fills

frost.$description: Frost — Cool dividers, section borders, subtle structural lines

chalk-line.$description: Chalk Line — Hairline borders, card edges, table separators — the dominant structural divider

electric-mint.$description: Electric Mint — Brand accent — stat labels, badge fills, primary highlight surface, install-pill glow; the single chromatic note that makes the monochrome system feel switched on

daffodil.$description: Daffodil — Secondary highlight — small emphasis marks, version badges, accent dots

sky-pop.$description: Sky Pop — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

sky-wash.$description: Sky Wash — Tinted background for blue-accented panels and muted blue surfaces

moss.$description: Moss — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

crimson.$description: Crimson — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

iris.$description: Iris — Violet supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

cobalt.$description: Cobalt — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

moranga.$description: Display and large headings — the weight-700 headlines at 72px and 44px carry the brand voice; tight tracking and a custom geometric construction give Moranga a technical-architectural stance that Inter cannot reproduce

inter.$description: Body text, nav, buttons, secondary headings, and most UI — the workhorse sans carries the system at every size below display, and the negative letter-spacing at large sizes mirrors the display tracking

menlo.$description: Code, terminal output, install commands — weight 650 for emphasis inside monospace blocks distinguishes commands from output without changing face

recursive.$description: Long-form prose and feature descriptions — a variable cousin to Inter used where reading rhythm matters more than UI density
